summary: Advises reporting Python 3 incompatibilities as bugs on Ansible's GitHub project, mentioning Python 3, and points to developer docs for fixing them.
questions: What should I do if a module fails only under Python 3?
Where do I report a Python 3 bug in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Reporting Python 3 incompatibilities
answer_card.answer_md: Edge-case bugs and unported community modules can still exist. Report them at https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/ and mention **Python 3** in the report. To fix it yourself, see the developing_python_3 guide before opening a pull request.
